examPattern: Mid-Sem: 2 Hours (30 Marks) | End-Sem: 3 Hours (50 Marks) | Lab: 20 Marks

units.title: Data Mining Fundamentals & Preprocessing
topics: Data Mining Architecture, Knowledge Discovery in Databases (KDD) Process
Data Cleaning: Handling Missing Values, Noisy Data, and Outlier Analysis
Data Integration, Transformation: Min-Max Normalization, Z-score, and Decimal Scaling
Data Reduction: Principal Component Analysis (PCA), Wavelet Transform, and Sampling
Exploratory Visual Data Analytics: Scatter Plots, Box Plots, and Parallel Coordinates

units.title: Association Rule Mining & Pattern Discovery
topics: Market Basket Analysis: Support, Confidence, and Lift Metrics
Apriori Algorithm: Candidate Generation, Pruning, and Efficiency Enhancements
FP-Growth Algorithm: Construction of Frequent Pattern Tree and Conditional Pattern Bases
Mining Multilevel and Multidimensional Association Rules

units.title: Cluster Analysis & Advanced Data Visualization
topics: Partitioning Methods: K-Means, K-Medoids (PAM), and CLARA
Hierarchical Methods: Agglomerative vs Divisive, BIRCH, and ROCK
Cluster Validation Metrics: Silhouette Coefficient and Davies-Bouldin Index
Interactive Dashboards, D3.js Visual Pipelines, and Multidimensional Mapping

textbooks: Jiawei Han, Micheline Kamber, Jian Pei, 'Data Mining: Concepts and Techniques', 3rd Edition, Morgan Kaufmann
Tamara Munzner, 'Visualization Analysis and Design', CRC Press
references: Pang-Ning Tan, Michael Steinbach, Vipin Kumar, 'Introduction to Data Mining', Pearson
Colin Ware, 'Information Visualization: Perception for Design', Morgan Kaufmann
